upstream.description: Structured multi-perspective deliberation for hard decisions. Run full councils, focused triads, or duo debates across Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and OpenCode.

classification.analysis: Council of High Intelligence is a multi-agent deliberation protocol distributed as a Claude Code plugin/skill (with mirrors for Codex, Gemini CLI, and OpenCode) that assigns a hard decision to 18 distinct analytical personas (Aristotle, Feynman, Taleb, etc.), forces independent analysis and cross-examination, then returns a verdict with dissent, kill criteria, and a concrete next step. It auto-detects available LLM providers (native host, OpenAI, Gemini, Ollama, NVIDIA NIM, Cursor) and routes council seats across them so a single model doesn't argue both sides. Aimed at solo builders/architects who want structured second opinions on high-stakes, irreversible decisions rather than a quick chat answer. Ships with a shell/Python installer, lint and release CI, and a documented protocol contract in SKILL.md.

use_cases.title: Get a structured second opinion before an irreversible architecture or strategy call
Run an adversarial debate across multiple LLM providers to pressure-test a plan
Install as a slash-command plugin for on-demand /council reviews in Claude Code
Route deliberation seats across Codex, Gemini, and Ollama to avoid single-model bias
Run a quick duo debate to settle a single high-tension tradeoff
